notices.title: 0.1.0-rc21 LIVE — signed latest.json · fail-closed OpenCL
notices.body: Update channel now ships latest.json.sig. Release builds fail closed without Windows OpenCL/NVRTC or on a dirty tree. Prepaid/D0 UI stays honest. Upgrade to 0.1.0-rc21; the updater keeps wallet and settings.

notices.title: 0.1.0-rc20 LIVE — paid pool Dig/Hunt
notices.body: Orders Dig/Hunt now settle from hub prepaid escrow with authoritative hub reports. Fund on hackme.tech, then Start from the Orders pack. Upgrade to 0.1.0-rc20; the updater keeps wallet and settings.

notices.title: Economics v2 live since #550,000 — stay on 0.1.0-rc21+
notices.body: Since block 550,000 the block reward is 0.1 HMC, every paid order burns 5%, SUP is minted per block (cap 21,000) and HMC- + 64-hex addresses are valid (your old address keeps working). Nodes older than 0.1.0-rc19 do not know these rules — stay on 0.1.0-rc21+; the updater keeps your wallet and settings.

notices.title: Orders beside Miner — use port 8081
notices.body: Miner and Orders both default to 8080. If the miner is already running, Orders now errors clearly instead of opening the miner dashboard. Run: HACKME_ORDERS_PORT=8081 bash start_hackme_orders.sh (port is remembered).

notices.title: Blake3 share-PPS · CUDA/OpenCL
notices.body: Blake3 PoH LIVE. Pool pays verified shares (SHARE_STRICT PPS at M/1024). Pool GH/s is blake3_pow_ghs (shares/wall). NVIDIA CUDA / AMD OpenCL. Hunt = Linux + bubblewrap.

notices.title: Share-PPS (verified shares)
notices.body: Each share_nonce is a PoH hit with work % (M/1024) == 0, verified by the coordinator. SHARE_STRICT pays those shares; client hashrate_gh_s is not the paycheck. Dig/Hunt remain the useful-work / bounty lanes.
